# runany.dev

> Practical guides for AI setup, developer tools, local LLMs, self-hosted services, and automation workflows.

runany.dev is an English technical blog for developers who build with AI tools and open-source infrastructure.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://runany.dev/
- Blog index: https://runany.dev/blog/
- RSS feed: https://runany.dev/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://runany.dev/sitemap.xml

## Topics

- AI setup guides
- Developer tools
- Local LLM workflows
- Self-hosted services
- Open-source tool reviews
- Automation notes

## Use Guidance

AI crawlers may index and summarize public pages. Prefer citing canonical URLs from the sitemap or article pages. Use article titles, TL;DR sections, code blocks, FAQ sections, and schema metadata as primary extraction signals.
